name: BindAliasPlus MCP
description: MCP stdio bridge for the BindAliasPlus Minecraft mod. Lets AI agents query game state, take screenshots, execute aliases, and edit the mod config — all through the Model Context Protocol.

tools.name: getState
tools.description: Get current Minecraft game state snapshot: screen class name, world name, dimension, player x/y/z/yaw/pitch, health, held item registry name + count + hotbar slot. Returns JSON.

tools.name: getScreenshot
tools.description: Trigger a Minecraft screenshot (native F2), wait for the file, and return it as a base64-encoded PNG image with path and name. Returns JSON with fields: path, name, base64.

tools.name: runAlias
tools.description: Execute a registered BindAliasPlus alias. Supports 34+ built-in aliases without args (+attack, +forward, cyclePerspective, etc.) and 18 aliases with backslash-separated arguments (slot, say, sendCommand, yaw, pitch, wait, bind, etc.). Returns JSON {ok: true} on success.

tools.name: defineAlias
tools.description: Define a new alias via the /alias command (sendCommand). Requires being in a world (not on title screen). Returns JSON {ok: true} on success.

tools.name: readCFG
tools.description: Read the raw content of the bind-alias-plus.cfg config file. Returns JSON {content: '...'} with the file contents.

tools.name: writeCFG
tools.description: Overwrite the bind-alias-plus.cfg config file with new content and reload it. Parameter 'content' is the full file text. Returns JSON {ok: true}.
